about: The Straw Hat Pirates corridor (js/s/strawhats.js). Hand-kept. 'mine' quotes are Goma's words, verbatim from his notes (source given). 'word' and 'lesson' marked draft:true were written by Claude as a starting point; rewrite them in Writer's mode and they become his. Bounties are the latest canon figures (post-Egghead).

finale.title: The Straw Hat Pirates
finale.line: Ten dreams. One ship. Still sailing.

crew.name: Monkey D. Luffy
crew.dream: To become King of the Pirates.
crew.lesson: Luffy taught me to dream without apologizing for it.

mine.text: Dream loudly. Protect your people. Keep moving.

crew.name: Roronoa Zoro
crew.dream: To become the world's greatest swordsman.
crew.lesson: Keep training. Keep aiming higher. Stop talking when action says more.

mine.text: Zoro reminded me that progress looks boring before it looks impressive. Train, improve, repeat.

crew.name: Nami
crew.dream: To draw a map of the whole world.
crew.lesson: Carrying everything alone isn't strength. The bravest thing she ever said was two words: help me.

mine.text: He does not need a giant speech. He understands what Nami is asking for, gives her his most precious possession, and walks toward the fight.
mine.from: Moment 01 · the straw hat on Nami

crew.name: Usopp
crew.dream: To become a brave warrior of the sea.
crew.lesson: Brave doesn't mean unafraid. It means your legs are shaking and you stand there anyway.

crew.name: Vinsmoke Sanji
crew.lesson: Work hard, feed people properly, and never treat food like it has no value.

mine.text: I learned to not waste food in any case because of him and how precious the food on the table is.

crew.name: Tony Tony Chopper
crew.dream: To become a doctor who can cure any disease.
crew.lesson: Being different isn't something to apologise for. The right people will call you a friend, horns and all.

crew.name: Nico Robin
crew.dream: To read the true history of the world.
crew.lesson: Your past does not get to decide whether you deserve a future.

mine.text: Robin reminded me that a terrible chapter does not mean the story should end there.

crew.name: Franky
crew.dream: To build a dream ship and sail it to the end of the world.
crew.lesson: Own your past, then build something worth sailing on.

crew.name: Brook
crew.lesson: Fifty years alone in the fog, and he kept laughing. Some promises are worth outliving everything for.

mine.text: A promise surviving across decades is exactly the kind of One Piece idea that sounds almost silly until the story absolutely destroys you with it.

crew.name: Jinbe
crew.dream: A world where fish-men and humans stand as equals.
crew.lesson: When everything falls apart, remember who is still counting on you.

mine.text: But once Jimbei asked don't you have others that are counting on you, the darkness, the emptiness slow began to fade away while remembering each straw-hats calling his name.
